question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Sakiri Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Devour Whole press Skill1+Skill2, Feast of Gluttony five UltraSkill1 plus one UltraSkill2, eating mode or interruption behavior.
decision: Devour Whole Press describes 167.8%+232.2% (matching native Skill1 and Skill2 rows). Feast of Gluttony describes 6 instances totaling 120%*5 + 300% (matching five instances of native UltraSkill1 plus one instance of native UltraSkill2). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; A4 buff and A5 reset callbacks trigger once per cast on the primary hit.
timing_hypothesis: sakiri.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 2000/1, 6855/2, 3702/1; Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 4500/1, 15426/2, 16658/2.
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 10 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, holding/eating mode, Scorch enhancement, Impish Trick debuff and full awakening effects remain pending.
